instruction: Query the OQMD database for Fe binary compounds (element_set=Fe AND ntypes=2) using limit=10. Sort the returned results by delta_e ascending in Python. Save the total count (data_available from API metadata) and the top 5 entries by delta_e (name/delta_e/spacegroup) to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_13.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
